quests.instruction: I have an enormous body and a giant heart. I live gliding through the deep ocean. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the blue whale! It has an enormous body and a giant heart and lives gliding through the deep ocean.
quests.funFact: A blue whale's heart is about the size of a small car.

quests.instruction: I have a big bushy tail and quick little paws. I live scampering up trees in the forest. I can climb and leap between branches. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the squirrel! It has a big bushy tail and quick little paws and lives scampering up trees in the forest.
quests.funFact: A squirrel's front teeth never stop growing.

quests.instruction: A group of animals is called a "raft". Which animal is it?
quests.hint: This animal has a sleek body and webbed paws.
quests.explanation: That's right! A group of otters is called a raft. You can find them floating belly-up on a calm river.
quests.funFact: Otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart.

quests.instruction: Which animal can glide slowly on a trail of slime?
quests.hint: This animal lives inching along a garden leaf.
quests.explanation: Yes! The snail can glide slowly on a trail of slime. It has a curly, spiral-shaped shell.
quests.funFact: A snail leaves a trail of slime to protect its body from sharp rocks.

quests.instruction: Which animal can fly and climb using a strong beak?
quests.hint: This animal lives perched in a colorful jungle tree.
quests.explanation: Yes! The parrot can fly and climb using a strong beak. It has bright, colorful feathers.
quests.funFact: Did you know? parrots are one of the few animals that can mimic human speech.

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with hundreds of sharp little spines?
quests.hint: This animal usually lives rustling through a garden at night.
quests.explanation: That's right! The hedgehog has hundreds of sharp little spines. You can find it rustling through a garden at night.
quests.funFact: Did you know? hedgehogs have thousands of sharp spines on their back for protection.

quests.instruction: One of these animals lives in a pond. Which one?
quests.hint: Look for the animal with bright pink feathers and long thin legs.
quests.explanation: Great job! The flamingo lives in a pond. You can spot it by bright pink feathers and long thin legs.
quests.funFact: Did you know? flamingos turn pink because of the shrimp and algae they eat.

quests.instruction: Which animal can dive underwater and flap fast in the air?
quests.hint: This animal lives nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.explanation: Yes! The puffin can dive underwater and flap fast in the air. It has a big, colorful striped beak.
quests.funFact: Puffins can hold dozens of small fish in their specialized beaks at once.

quests.instruction: I have smooth flippers and big round eyes. I live resting on icy Arctic rocks. I can glide gracefully through icy water. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the seal! It has smooth flippers and big round eyes and lives resting on icy Arctic rocks.
quests.funFact: Seals can hold their breath underwater for up to two hours.

quests.instruction: I have a sleek body and webbed paws. I live floating belly-up on a calm river. I can float, dive, and slide playfully. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the otter! It has a sleek body and webbed paws and lives floating belly-up on a calm river.
quests.funFact: They use rocks as tools to smash open hard clam shells.

quests.instruction: I have huge round eyes and silent wings. I live in a tree in a quiet forest. I say "Hoot"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the owl! It has huge round eyes and silent wings and lives in a tree in a quiet forest.
quests.funFact: Owls cannot move their eyes inside their sockets.

quests.instruction: I have a long neck and orange webbed feet. I live on a farm pond. I say "Honk"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the goose! It has a long neck and orange webbed feet and lives on a farm pond.
quests.funFact: If a goose gets sick, another goose will stay with it until it recovers.

quests.instruction: Which animal has a huge mouth and short round legs?
quests.hint: This animal usually lives cooling off in a river.
quests.explanation: That's right! The hippo has a huge mouth and short round legs. It says "Grunt".
quests.funFact: Did you know? despite their heavy bodies, hippos can run very fast on land.

quests.instruction: I have a very long neck and long legs. I live reaching up on the plains. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the giraffe! It has a very long neck and long legs and lives reaching up on the plains.
quests.funFact: Giraffes only need to sleep for a few minutes at a time.

quests.instruction: I have a sleek body and webbed paws. I live floating belly-up on a calm river. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the otter! It has a sleek body and webbed paws and lives floating belly-up on a calm river.
quests.funFact: An otter has incredibly thick fur to keep it warm in freezing water.

quests.instruction: What do we call a baby hippo?
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like a huge mouth and short round legs.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby hippo is called a calf. Grown-up hippos live cooling off in a river.
quests.funFact: Elephant calves are protected fiercely by the entire herd.

quests.instruction: I have a round red shell with black spots. I live resting on a garden leaf. I can crawl and fly short hops. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the ladybug! It has a round red shell with black spots and lives resting on a garden leaf.
quests.funFact: Did you know? ladybugs are actually a type of beetle, not a bug.

quests.instruction: I have a curly tail and a round pink nose. I live on a muddy farm. I say "Oink"! What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the pig! It has a curly tail and a round pink nose and lives on a muddy farm.
quests.funFact: They do not have sweat glands, so they roll in mud to cool down.

quests.instruction: A baby seal has a special name. What is it called?
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like smooth flippers and big round eyes.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby seal is called a pup. Grown-up seals live resting on icy Arctic rocks.
quests.funFact: Seal pups are born with a fluffy white coat to stay warm on the ice.

quests.instruction: Which animal can hover in place by flapping super fast?
quests.hint: This animal lives darting between bright garden flowers.
quests.explanation: Yes! The hummingbird can hover in place by flapping super fast. It has a tiny body and a long thin beak.
quests.funFact: Did you know? hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards.

quests.instruction: A baby animal is called a "pup". Which animal is its parent?
quests.hint: The grown-up animal lives flying through the night sky.
quests.explanation: Correct! A baby bat is called a pup. The bat has wide wings and the ability to sleep upside down.
quests.funFact: A single brown bat can catch over 1,000 mosquitoes in just one hour.

quests.instruction: Who is able to creep slowly along branches? Choose the right animal!
quests.hint: This animal lives hiding among jungle leaves.
quests.explanation: Yes! The chameleon can creep slowly along branches. It has skin that can change color.
quests.funFact: Did you know? a chameleon's tongue can be twice as long as its body.

quests.instruction: I have a big, colorful striped beak. I live nesting on a cold, rocky cliff. I can dive underwater and flap fast in the air. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the puffin! It has a big, colorful striped beak and lives nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.funFact: Their colorful beaks actually fade to gray during the winter.

quests.instruction: I have strong back legs and a built-in baby pouch. I live hopping across the land in Australia. I can hop in big leaps. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the kangaroo! It has strong back legs and a built-in baby pouch and lives hopping across the land in Australia.
quests.funFact: A group of kangaroos is called a mob.

quests.instruction: I have round fuzzy ears and a big black nose. I live resting in a eucalyptus tree in Australia. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the koala! It has round fuzzy ears and a big black nose and lives resting in a eucalyptus tree in Australia.
quests.funFact: A baby koala is called a joey.

quests.instruction: I have long jaws and rows of sharp teeth. I live floating quietly in a river. I can glide through water and lie very still. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the crocodile! It has long jaws and rows of sharp teeth and lives floating quietly in a river.
quests.funFact: Did you know? they cannot chew their food, so they swallow stones to help grind it up.

quests.instruction: I have a big, colorful striped beak. I live nesting on a cold, rocky cliff. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the puffin! It has a big, colorful striped beak and lives nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.funFact: Puffins are excellent swimmers and 'fly' underwater to catch fish.

quests.instruction: I have very strong arms and a broad chest. I live resting in a misty rainforest. I can walk on strong knuckles. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the gorilla! It has very strong arms and a broad chest and lives resting in a misty rainforest.
quests.funFact: Did you know? gorillas can learn sign language and communicate with humans.

quests.instruction: I have smooth flippers and big round eyes. I live resting on icy Arctic rocks. What am I?
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the seal! It has smooth flippers and big round eyes and lives resting on icy Arctic rocks.
quests.funFact: They have a thick layer of fat called blubber to stay warm in freezing water.

quests.instruction: A baby deer has a special name. What is it called?
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like tall branching antlers.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby deer is called a fawn. Grown-up deer live grazing quietly in the forest.
quests.funFact: A baby deer is called a fawn.
